long_biography.plain_text:
Protecting large landscapes has become Louis Bacon's defining public contribution beyond investment management. The Moore Charitable Foundation supports organisations working on open land, healthy forests, clean water and marine habitats. Bacon was also instrumental in establishing Waterkeeper Alliance, connecting local clean-water groups through a wider international network.

His most consequential project placed land in Colorado's Sangre de Cristo Mountains under permanent protection. The conservation easement provided the foundation for a landscape-scale federal conservation area, linking wildlife habitat with working ranchland near Great Sand Dunes National Park. Bacon has extended this model through affiliated foundations in North Carolina, New Mexico, New York and the Bahamas.

uncertainties.detail: Forbes says trading profits and a small inheritance funded Moore Capital's launch and classifies the resulting fortune as self-made. The core hedge-fund platform was separately built, so the inheritance is treated as a starting advantage rather than an inherited core asset. Its amount and proportion of the launch capital are not published in the current profile.

Moore Capital returned outside investor capital in 2019 but continues to manage internal money. Current first-party profiles still identify Bacon as chairman and principal investment manager, supporting Finance & Investments as the primary industry and Founder as the relationship without relying on current fund values or performance.

Raleigh and 25 July 1956 are published in the well-cited existing Wikipedia profile. The Nature Conservancy independently calls Raleigh his hometown, his official site calls him a North Carolina native, and Forbes's current age corroborates the year, but no first-party source reviewed here publishes the complete date.

The official personal, company and Forbes pages are proposed. No identity-verified personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X, YouTube or TikTok account cleared the acceptance threshold; the existing Wikipedia link is retained without alteration.

The official record contains acreage totals and award lists that may date as new work continues. The long biography uses durable programme, easement and regional facts while omitting current aggregate acreage and award inventories.

Current and historical vessel material, private relationships, political activity, allegations, controversies, disputes, current rankings, net-worth values, portfolio positions and transient investment performance were excluded from the biographies and accepted proposals.

Secondary nationality remains unproposed because no strong, scope-appropriate source was accepted for it. Title, name suffix and secondary residence remain optional. Death, death-age, internal-note and unknown-name fields remain inapplicable or system-managed for a living person.
